description: This file defines the AsyncTimer class, which implements an asynchronous timer with health checks, overshoot detection, and logging capabilities within the Orleans.Runtime namespace.

classes.name: AsyncTimer
classes.description: An internal class implementing IAsyncTimer, providing asynchronous timing, health checking, and overshoot logging functionalities.

methods.name: NextTick
methods.description: Returns a task that completes after the calculated delay, handling cancellation and overshoot detection.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Checks if the timer has fired as expected, returning false with a reason if it has overshot.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cancels the timer and resets internal state.
